observations: Rival survival is determined solely by demonstration inputs and verified demonstration labels; query input is then used only to determine whether a surviving rival changes the answer.
The sealed Mapping probe allowed access only to input; enumeration and all private key reads were prohibited. The result matched poisoned query-label and private-metadata variants exactly.

Malformed inputs and demonstration structures were rejected before the supplied reference callback. Wrong but well-formed demo labels were invalid. Invalid reference outputs and reference exceptions produced reference_error.
Reference receives copied input rows; deliberate callback input mutation did not alter caller demos/query or gate result.
The CLI source uses the pinned canonical Racket rule and compares its outputs with the Python mirror. This independent probe exercised the pure gate, not the CLI or a fresh Racket runtime.
limitations: A pass is a query-relevant result against one declared rival; it is not universal identifiability or training approval. A surviving rival may pass when both predictors agree on the query.
The 40-case matrix is finite. No adversarial arbitrary-object method execution, CLI runtime-startup fault injection, large seed census, full test suite, or additional Racket run was performed.
The existing test file was read for coverage but not separately rerun in this review.
